name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Matilda goes with 2 coins or someone in the Ironmongers' Guild goes with Edmund (but not both).
Between Carpenter and 4 coins, one goes with Aldric and the other with Matilda.
If either 4 coins goes with Potter or Beatrix does not go with Blacksmith, then Aldric goes with 4 coins.
Either Matilda goes with Potter or 6 coins goes with Blacksmith.
Exactly one of these is true: Aldric goes with Blacksmith; Beatrix goes with 8 coins; Edmund goes with 2 coins.
